description: Unit test class for EmployeeReportingMethodService in OrangeHRM PIM plugin, testing various methods related to employee reporting hierarchies and data fetching.

classes.description: Test class for EmployeeReportingMethodService, containing unit tests for methods related to employee reporting hierarchy management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodDao
